title: Canonical comparison of closed tensors with a common internal Hom
statement: Let D be a category and H : $D^{op} \times D \to D$ a bifunctor. For closed tensor structures S,T for H [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], the uniqueness-of-left-adjoints comparisons form a natural isomorphism $S.tensor \simeq T.tensor$, natural in both tensor variables. Its composite with T evaluation is S evaluation, and precomposing with its hom (respectively inv) carries the T (respectively S) tensor-Hom transpose to the S (respectively T) transpose. On equal structures it is the equality-transport isomorphism. No symmetry or rigidity hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq for each fixed second tensor parameter. Transpose the naturality square in both parameters; naturality of evaluation in the internal-Hom source proves the second-parameter square. The first-parameter square is adjunction naturality.

proof.text: The counit identity is leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit. The transpose identity follows from homEquiv_naturality_right and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Cancel hom with inv for the inverse identity. Eliminate equality of structures and use leftAdjointUniq_refl for equality transport.
